about: The map's table of contents (0.2 map line, 2026-11-20): every class of thing in the system and the one table that is its source. 'reader' is the package that loads the source; the class belongs to that package's domain in config/domain-ownership.json. 'also' are other places that say the same class: each is a second source to merge into the first or to generate from it. A class with no source is 'unmeasured', not empty.

classes.what: the domains, their tier and contracts
who owns each Go package of the platform
who owns code outside the Go packages and the console groups (mcp/, agent/, scripts/, config files, root files)
classes.note: the paths section; a Go package is covered only by its package row

classes.what: who owns each front-end directory of the console
what no row covers, with first-seen time and review
classes.note: the pool itself is kept by the scan (statefile catalog/unperceived-<repo>); the file holds the claim (with the proposed domain), delete and unknown verdicts, each with a reason

classes.what: the event types on the bus and who subscribes
the catalogued actions and their tiers
the machines of the cluster and their roles
also: compute line's home table (outside this repository)

classes.what: dev, stg, prod and how to reach them
the Trade API's route groups the probes read
the lines (seats) and what each runs
classes.note: one charter per seat (Owner 2026-11-15); a file list, not yet a table with each seat's domain
no table: the list is the machine's, not typed; a repository with no ownership table is listed by directory in the pool; a tenant's is kept as one entry (Owner 2026-11-20)
classes.live: the Gitea organization's repositories (non-archived, non-empty), listed each round

classes.what: the platform database's tables and who owns each
classes.note: the tables section: a schema row covers its tables, a <schema>/<table> row one table; what no row covers is in the pool of repository "platform-db". The platform's own database only (Owner 2026-11-20); the tenants' are tenant-data-table
classes.live: the tables of the platform's database (pg_tables of the agentrt environment's database), listed each round

classes.note: the workloads section: a namespace row covers its workloads, a <namespace>/<name> row one workload (the run key agreed with the metrics line); what no row covers is in the pool of repository "cluster"
classes.live: the cluster's workloads (Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, CronJobs of every namespace), listed each round

classes.what: the Trade, Research and Finance databases' tables
classes.note: not read this round: the tenants have databases of their own, apart from the platform's (Owner 2026-11-20: the platform's own first)
